integrity: All 141120 normalized maps are exhaustively enumerated with two separately implemented complete subset searches; their full histograms agree. This is a same mathematical model proof/code assessment, without an independent external audit.
limitations: Exact finite classification only: one distinguished 8-cycle and one rank-7 map, up to rotations. Does not generalize to arbitrary state counts or determine all shortest reset words; published priority could be affected by unindexed historical data.
title: Complete reset-threshold spectrum for eight-state circular defect-one automata
